facts.fact: The Consorcio Eleitoral Mais Integridade observer report says the 2023 voter registration was carried out with mobile digital biometric kits (laptop, ten-finger scanner, camera, signature screen, card printer), used from field capture through data storage and compilation of the final rolls.
facts.system: recenseamento eleitoral biometrico (STAE biometric registration kits)

systems.system: Recenseamento eleitoral biometrico (STAE mobile biometric registration kits)
systems.platform: mobile biometric kits with registration software and PVC voter card printers

facts.fact: The Commonwealth Observer Group says the CNE has used biometric voter registration technology since 2008 and that 17,169,239 voters were registered for the 2024 elections.

The Commonwealth Observer Group says copies of the voter register are displayed where registration brigades operated so voters can scrutinise it and complain in writing, and that the final register was published on 4-9 July 2024.

systems.platform: biometric registration systems bought from a Artes Graficas and Laxton consortium

note: Linked not recorded: the law requires the Civil Registry to send monthly lists of deaths, but the report says regular updates may not have happened.

facts.fact: Mozambique's electoral secretariat (STAE) registered over 2.4 million voters in the first 15 days of the 2024 registration using Mobile ID kits, 32% of the 7.7 million target, according to AIM.
